DOP: pāni pānī m. [ cf pāna, pānīya], water for drinking; Ja VI 109, 30* (ghammābhitattā manujā pivanti pītaṃ ca tesaṃ bhusa hoti ~i, Be so; Ce, Ee pivataṃ ca tesaṃ bhusaṃ; Se pivataṃ ca tesaṃ thusaṃ; 110, 8´ : ~ī ti pānīyaṃ … pānīyaṃ bhusapalāsabhāvaṃ āpajjitvā pajjalati, Be so; Ce, Ee bhusapalāpabhāvaṃ; Se thusapalāsabhāvaṃ) quoted Sadd 914, 13 foll. (pānīyan ti vattabbe ~ī ti pāṭho); Sadd 408, 18* (pānīyaṃ udakaṃ … ~i); — °- ghaṭa , m.n. [pāni + ghaṭa 1 ], a large water-jar; Ap 437, 3 (pasannacitto sumano ~am apūrayiṃ, Se so; Be pānī-; Ce, Ee pānīya-).

pāṇi m. ( and f. ?) 1. [ ts ] ( pl. nom. acc. ~ī, ~ayo, ~iyo; instr. ~ibhi, ~ihi, ~īhi), the hand; Abh 265 (hattho tu karapāṇayo); 1007 (~i hatthe); Vin I 28, 28 (Sakko devānam indo … ~inā pokkharaṇiṃ khaṇitvā); 347, 36 (Brahmadatto ca Kāsirājā Dīghāvu ca kumāro aññamaññassa jīvitaṃ adaṃsu ~iṃ ca aggahesuṃ sapathaṃ ca akaṃsu adrūbhāya); D III 92, 19 (aññe ~inā pahariṃsu aññe leḍḍunā pahariṃsu); M I 86, 24 (aññamaññaṃ ~īhi pi upakkamanti); II 138, 2 (na ca ~inā ālambitvā āsane nisīdati); S I 82, 18 (~inā gattāni anumajjanto); II 198, 17 (bhagavā ākāse ~iṃ cālesi); A III 17, 14 (ime pi candimasuriye … ~inā parāmaseyyaṃ); 337, 16* (datvā sakehi ~ibhi); Dhp 124 (~imhi ca vaṇo nāssa hareyya ~inā visaṃ); Vv 6:1 (padmaṃ chindasi ~inā); Pv 21:11 (~i te sabbasovaṇṇo pañcadhāro madhussavo; Pv-a 119, 10 : tava dakkhiṇahattho); Th 481 (saṃharitvāna ~ayo, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pāṇiyo); 758 (gambhīre patitassa me thalaṃ ~iṃ ca dassaye, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ~i va; Th-a III 30, 22 foll.: nibbānathalaṃ taṃsampāpakaṃ ariyamaggahatthaṃ ca dasseyya); Ja I 138, 3 (taṃ palitaṃ uddharitvā ~imhi ṭhapehī ti); II 317, 15* (pasārayī kicchagatassa ~iṃ); III 172, 15* (ahaṃ h’ imaṃ sāgarasevitantaṃ samaṃ karissāmi yathā pi ~i, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~iṃ); IV 11, 16* (duṭṭhassa … tato ~i tato daṇḍo; 12, 6´ : upakkamanavasena ~i pavattati); V 407, 11* (sā taṃ patiggayha ubhohi ~ibhi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~ihi); VI 309, 31* (allaṃ ca ~iṃ parivajjayassu, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee addaṃ); 343, 16´ (~iṃ paharitvā mahāhasitaṃ hasitvā); Ap 65, 26 (pādāsiṃ pasanno sehi ~ibhi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~ihi); Mil 60, 16 (yathā mahārāja dve ~ī vajjeyyuṃ); 193, 6 (koci puriso parassa ~inā pahāraṃ dadeyya); Ps II 329, 21 (paraṃ jīvitā voropentassa ~ī lohitena lippanti, Be, Ce so; Ee ~i; Se ~i … lippati); III 75, 25 (manussā ~inā ~iṃ paharitvā … hasantā keḷiṃ karonti); Dīp 9:29 (~ī passanti sobhanā); — ifc see adubbha- ( sv dubbha ), onītapatta- ( sv onīyati ), khura- ( sv khura 1 ), cakka-, chatta- ( sv chatta 1 ), daṇḍa-, patta- ( sv patta 3 ), payata- ( sv payacchati ), piṭṭhi-; — 2. an instrument for smoothing or rubbing; a hawk or trowel; Abh 1007 (~i … bhūsaṇhakaraṇiyaṃ); Pv-a 56, 28 (muggarahatthapāṇino ti … bhūmisaṇhakaraṇīyādīsu ~ino vohārassa labbhamānattā hatthasaddena ~i visesito); Ap 173, 3 (bodhivediṃ akās’ ahaṃ, sudhāya piṇḍaṃ datvāna °-kammaṃ akās’ ahaṃ; Ap-a 443, 12 foll.: sārakaṭṭhena phalakapāṇiyo katvā tāhi ~īhi maṭṭhakammaṃ akāsin ti attho, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee katvā ~īhi maṭṭhaṃ kammaṃ akāsin ti); — ifc see phalaka-; — °- ggaha , m. [ S. pāṇigraha], marriage; Abh 318; — °- gha , m. [pāṇi + gha 4 ], one who strikes (an instrument) with the hands, a drummer; Abh 511 (pāṇivādo tu ~o, Be so; Ce pāṇiyo); — °- mutta , n. , a weapon propelled by the hands; Abh 387 (~aṃ tu satyādi, eds so; for sattyādi?); — °- vāda , m. , one who strikes (an instrument) with the hands; Abh 511; — °- ssara , m. [pāṇi + sara 5 ; cf BHS pāṇisvara], the playing of instruments with the hand, drumming; a kind of drum; clapping the hands; one who drums or claps the hands; ? D I 6, 12 (naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ pekkhaṃ akkhānaṃ ~aṃ vetālaṃ kumbhathūnaṃ …; Sv 84, 17 : ~an ti kaṃsatālaṃ, pāṇitālan ti pi vadanti) = Nidd I 366, 23 ; Ja V 390, 25* (~ā mutiṅgā ca … suttam etaṃ pabodhenti); 506, 9* (~aṃ kumbhathūnaṃ … hitvā); VI 276, 28* (~e kumbhathūnike maṇimhi passa; 277, 1´ : ~e ti pāṇippahārena gāyante); 580, 27* ; Ps III 324, 8 (sā ~aṃ karontī mahāsaddaṃ akāsi); — see also pāṇikā, pāsapāṇika ( sv pāsa 1 ).

pāṇi(n) mfn. and m.f.n. [ S. prāṇin] ( pl. acc. ~ino, ~ine ( and ~ayo?), gen. ~īnaṃ, ~inaṃ mc, loc. ~īsu, ~isu mc ), having life; a living being; a living entity; Abh 93 (pāṇo … jīvo ~i pajā …); 1007 (~i … satte); Vin IV 204, 14* (pacant’ aññe pi ~ino); S I 18, 22* (puññāni paralokasmiṃ patiṭṭhā honti ~inaṃ); 210, 15* (yathā saddhammasavanaṃ dukkhā moceti ~inaṃ; Spk I 311, 1 : ke mocetī ti ~ine ti āharitvā vattabbaṃ); A I 147, 11* (ahaṃ ce taṃ jiguccheyyaṃ evaṃdhammesu ~isu); Dhp 135 (evaṃ jarā ca maccu ca āyuṃ pājenti ~inaṃ); Sn 201 (kākā gijjhā ca khādanti ye c’ aññe ~ino, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pāṇayo); 220 (niccaṃ munī rakkhati ~ine yato); 587 (passa … phandante v’ idha ~ine; Pj II 461, 6 foll.: maraṇabhayena phandamāne yeva idha satte); Pv 33:9 (svāhaṃ divā hanitvā ~ino); Th 553 (jātā jātā marantīdha evaṃdhammā hi ~ino); 603 (dukkhaṃ pappontu ~ino); Ja I 168, 7* (na pāṇo ~inaṃ haññe); II 413, 26* (aticc’ aññe va ~ino, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee atīv’ aññe, prob. wr ); V 239, 16* (catunnaṃ yev’ upādāya rūpaṃ sambhoti ~inaṃ); 326, 30* (ādicco … ~īnaṃ pavidaṃseti rūpaṃ kalyāṇapāpakaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~inaṃ); Ap 464, 2 (nimugge mohapaṅkamhi samuddharati ~ino); Sv 307, 33 (yaññāvāṭaṃ pavisitvā sabbe te ~ayo bandhanā mocehī ti); Dīp 12:19 (Laṅkādīpavaraṃ gaccha dhammaṃ desehi ~inaṃ); Mhv 12:22 (sukhakāmā hi ~ino); Sadd 674, 22 foll. (vajjadassi icc evamādīnaṃ anto aṃ yo smiṃ su icc etesu inattaṃ āpajjati vā … ~inaṃ passati ~ine passati …); — apāṇi(n) , mfn. , without breath, without life; Ps I 216, 22 (mandadasakādīsu pāṇīnaṃ viya ca pupphaphalapallavādīsu ca ~īnaṃ viya) = Spk II 12, 26 ; Sadd 697, 4 (maññatipayoge anādare ~ini).
